_comment: Harvard data sources. `python -m electable harvard` downloads every file in each listed Dataverse dataset to data/raw/dataverse/<doi>/ and every URL in electit.urls to data/raw/electit/. Add the ElectIt replication DOI or file links from https://gking.harvard.edu/electit/ once known.

dataverse_datasets.name: MIT Election Lab: County presidential returns 2000-
Ebanks, Katz & King replication data (verify this DOI is the right one)

electit._urls_note: Direct links to ElectIt's published forecast/input files (CSV, TSV, XLSX, JSON). Files can also be dropped into data/raw/electit/ by hand.
electit._column_map_note: Only needed if auto-detection fails, e.g. {"state": "st", "district": "cd", "p_dem": "prob_d", "chamber": "office", "set": "model"}.
electit._ensemble_note: 0 = show ElectIt beside Electable only. 0 < w <= 1 blends ElectIt's race probabilities into Electable's race means (see model.blend_external).
